objective:
Add reset-aware telemetry usage reporting to the installable telemetry_usage API. Add POST /telemetry/usage with JSON {start,end,samples}; start/end are strict integers 0..1000000000 and start<end. samples is a list of at most 200 objects with exactly {device,at,reading}; device is a string of 1..40 Unicode code points, at and reading are strict integers 0..1000000000. Reject booleans, integer strings, unknown fields, invalid shapes/ranges and duplicate (device,at) pairs with HTTP422. Duplicates anywhere in samples are invalid, even outside the requested window. Detail wording is unspecified.

For each device, sort all its samples by at. Consider samples with start<at<=end. Include only devices with at least one sample in that window, sorted by device in Python string order. Each included sample contributes a delta relative to its immediately preceding sample for the same device, even if that preceding sample is outside the window. If no preceding sample exists, delta is zero. If the reading is at least the preceding reading, delta is their difference. Otherwise the counter reset: delta is the current reading and reset count increments. Only transitions ending within the window contribute. Return {start,end,devices:[{device,increase:sum of deltas,resets:reset count,samples:window sample count,last_reading:latest window reading}]}. Empty samples returns an empty devices list. Do not invent a reading at the window start or carry state between requests.

Expose domain.usage(samples,start,end) for direct callers with valid request shapes/types (duplicates still raise ValueError); do not mutate inputs on success or rejection. Wire this function through the real HTTP route. Preserve src-layout packaging, GET /health={status:"ok"}, POST /sum strict integer behavior, missing-route404, and the existing app import target telemetry_usage.app:app.

Use only the approved profile: CPython3.12.13, FastAPI0.115.12, Uvicorn0.34.2, Pydantic2.13.5, HTTPX0.28.1 for tests and setuptools78.1.0 offline build backend. Keep declared runtime/build dependencies unchanged and do not download packages. Add at least three meaningful unittest methods discoverable after wheel installation with python -m unittest discover -s /path/to/project, covering ordinary usage, a window/reset boundary and rejection. Tests and documented commands must work from arbitrary working directories. Expand README.md to at least 40 words, explicitly include /telemetry/usage and the actual server target telemetry_usage.app:app, explain window/reset/rejection behavior, and give a request/response example plus working server and test commands. No particular package-installation tool name is required. Output JSON types are exact: booleans are not integers. Budget: three attempts, 24 turns per attempt, 900 seconds.
